note: 18 targets, unpriced (first-season league, no bidding history). My roster is full (15/15, all 5 bench spots used) and every starting slot is filled -- Zay Flowers is active and starting (hamstring called 'not considered serious'), correcting this morning's board, which had him on IR. No empty-slot claim applies this cycle. Top adds are bench insurance behind an already-full lineup: Mack Hollins as A.J. Brown's direct Patriots replacement, Carson Wentz as QB2 insurance with Kyler Murray's concussion clearance still unresolved, and rookie Caleb Douglas as a named Week 1 starter at 91% snaps. All three name Rachaad White (lowest touch share of my three bench RBs, in an 8-RB-deep roster) as the most droppable piece.
